As of December 2022, all [[American Eagle (airline brand)|American Eagle]] flights operated by [[Envoy Air]] on behalf of [[American Airlines]] between Abilene (ABI) and Dallas/Ft. Worth (DFW) were being flown with [[Embraer E-Jet family|Embraer E175]] regional jets. [[United Express]] flights operated on behalf of [[United Airlines]] by [[SkyWest Airlines]] to Houston and Denver are operated by [[Bombardier CRJ100/200|Bombardier CRJ-200]] aircraft.
